lines.text: Israel reached Kadesh-barnea, and Moses selected twelve men, one from each tribe, to search out the land.
The spies came to the Valley of Eshcol and carried some of the land's fruit down to the people.
The LORD swore that no man of that generation would see the land except Caleb son of Nun.
The LORD told the people to head for the wilderness toward the Dead Sea, but they said they would go up and fight.
The Amorites chased Israel like bees from Seir to Hormah, and the people then stayed in Kadesh a long time.
